hooks.comment: 检查md文件中的断链引用
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *.md) grep -oE '`(docs/[^`]+|[A-Z]+\.md|\.claude/skills/[^`]+)`' "$FP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '`' | while read ref; do [ ! -f "$ref" ] && echo "WARNING: 断链引用 $ref 在 $FP 中" || true; done || true ;; esac; true

INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in */reports/*.md) case "$FP" in */reports/*/[A-Z]*) echo "✓ 报告路径正确: $FP" ;; *) echo "WARNING: 铁律E违反 — 报告应放入 reports/{TICKER}/ 子目录" ;; esac || true ;; esac; true

hooks.comment: 前台成品无痕化检查 — Complete文件写入时自动检查内部标签残留
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *_Complete_*.md) ISSUES=''; C1=$(grep -ciE '^#+.*Phase [0-9]' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C2=$(grep -cE 'DM-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C3=$(grep -ciE 'RT-[0-9]|CQ[0-9]|KS-[0-9]' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C4=$(grep -ci '回流\|校正后\|修正前\|旧版本' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C5=$(grep -ciE 'v22|v23|harness|framework v|框架版本' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C6=$(grep -cE '[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*/[0-9]+(分|score)' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C7=$(grep -ci '减仓\|加仓\|全部卖出\|买入' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); C8=$(grep -ci '入侵\|invade\|invasion' "$FP" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$C1" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}Phase标签残留($C1) "; [ "$C2" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}DM锚点残留($C2) "; [ "$C3" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}RT/CQ/KS残留($C3) "; [ "$C4" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}回流痕迹残留($C4) "; [ "$C5" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}框架版本残留($C5) "; [ "$C6" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}评分系统残留($C6) "; [ "$C7" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}仓位建议残留($C7) "; [ "$C8" -gt 0 ] && ISSUES="${ISSUES}台海合规违反($C8) "; if [ -n "$ISSUES" ]; then echo "BLOCK: 前台成品无痕化检查失败 — $ISSUES"; else echo "✓ 前台成品无痕化检查通过"; fi ;; esac; true

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$CMD" in *phase_complete.sh*) PHASE=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 2>/dev/null || echo ''); TICKER=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE '[A-Z]{2,5}' | head -1 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$TICKER" ] && [ -n "$PHASE" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Phase $PHASE 完成 — 请调用Evaluator Agent进行独立审计。读取sprint_contract_P${PHASE}.yaml和staging产出，产出eval_verdict_P${PHASE}.yaml\"}"; fi ;; esac; true

INPUT=$(cat); SKILL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$SKILL" in expectation-gap) echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"预期差识别器已执行，请验证E→R→G→T四步输出\"}" ;; lens-crystallization) echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Lens Crystallization完成，请验证Top 5 Quality Gate (6条)和Late Angle Gate\"}" ;; editorial-frontend) echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Editorial Frontend完成，请确认双版本产出(Complete+Audit)并运行无痕化检查\"}" ;; sprint-contract) echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Sprint Contract已生成，Generator和Evaluator请读取contract文件\"}" ;; esac; true

hooks.comment: Phase staging字符门控 — 写入staging时检查字符是否达到预算50%
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in */staging/*_P[0-9]*.md) CHARS=$(echo "$CONTENT" | wc -m | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHARS" -lt 10000 ]; then echo "WARNING: staging文件仅${CHARS}字符，请确认Phase输出是否充分（密度达标则允许提交）"; fi ;; esac; true
